scientific_integrity: All positive four-run parameters are covered by the proof; bounded enumeration is corroborative, not an infinite certificate. No assertion of independent audit or definitive literature uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabets and exactly four maximal constant runs only; no classification of minimum-attractor locations or five-plus-run words; a synonymous prior publication cannot be excluded.
title: Exact minimum string-attractor classification and census for binary four-run words
